name: Chro
source:
She is an energetic young woman that persistent and never give up. A little bit fool, and looks defendless, but in fact, she's pretty strong character. Also, she is a hot-blooded naive woman that travel around the world to fullfill her desire: to collect handsome-man photographs as much as she can. Even she always being rejected to take their pictures, she won't give up and will do whatever it takes to do her ambition, as long as it won't hurt her pride. She was a happy-go-lucky type of person anyway. 

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=24756]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
